symbols.name: precision
symbols.meaning: The number of fractional binary places kept, which sets the grid spacing to $2^{-p}$.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional binary places kept, so the grid spacing is $2^{-p}$.

symbols.name: coefficient list
symbols.meaning: A finite list of complex numbers, called coefficients.
symbols.quote: Let $z$ be a finite list of complex numbers, called coefficients.

symbols.name: truncation map
symbols.meaning: The map that truncates each real and imaginary part of each coefficient of a list toward zero to the grid $2^{-p}\mathbb{Z}$.
symbols.quote: Then $Q_p z$ is the list obtained by truncating each real and imaginary part of each coefficient toward zero to the grid $2^{-p}\mathbb{Z}$.

symbols.name: maximum norm
symbols.meaning: The largest complex modulus of any coefficient of a list.
symbols.quote: The error of truncation is measured by the [Array norm](array-norm.md) $\|\cdot\|_\infty$, the largest complex modulus of any coefficient.

symbols.name: layer
symbols.meaning: The operation that applies a two-point map to each pair of entries whose addresses differ in one of several selected bits, in one pass.
symbols.quote: A layer, written $H$, is one pass that replaces each pair of values $(\alpha,\beta)$ by $((\alpha+\beta)/2,(\alpha-\beta)/2)$, for every pair of entries whose addresses differ in one of several selected bits.

symbols.name: first paired value
symbols.meaning: The first of the two values that the layer combines in each pair.
symbols.quote: A layer, written $H$, is one pass that replaces each pair of values $(\alpha,\beta)$ by $((\alpha+\beta)/2,(\alpha-\beta)/2)$, for every pair of entries whose addresses differ in one of several selected bits.

symbols.name: second paired value
symbols.meaning: The second of the two values that the layer combines in each pair.
symbols.quote: A layer, written $H$, is one pass that replaces each pair of values $(\alpha,\beta)$ by $((\alpha+\beta)/2,(\alpha-\beta)/2)$, for every pair of entries whose addresses differ in one of several selected bits.
